page_title: MindMac — Elegant and Fullfil ChatGPT Client for macOS

sources.entry: MindMac - AI chat client for multiple providers in one place.

summary.name: MindMac
summary.one_liner: MindMac is a native macOS desktop client for chatting with ChatGPT and other AI model providers, with an Inline mode for using AI in any app.
use_cases: chat with ChatGPT from a Mac desktop app
insert AI-generated text into Notes, Mail or browsers via Inline mode
use multiple AI providers in one app
run local LLMs through Ollama or LM Studio
reuse prompt templates and AI occupation presets
search and export past AI conversations
summary.what_it_does: MindMac is a macOS app that connects to OpenAI ChatGPT, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, Mistral, Groq and other providers, as well as local LLMs via Ollama, LM Studio, LocalAI, GPT4All, llama.cpp and MLX servers. Its Inline mode lets users type a trigger command such as /gpt in any text field to insert generated content without switching windows. The app includes a prompt library with over 150 built-in templates, conversation organization in nested folders, history search, and context modes that control how many previous messages are sent. It stores the API key in the macOS Keychain and sends data directly to the provider rather than through intermediary servers. Export options include PDF, Markdown and ShareGPT, and some features include internet browsing, document upload, DALL·E image generation and text-to-speech.
notable: Inline mode inserts AI output into any macOS app via trigger commands
Stores API keys in macOS Keychain; data goes directly to provider
Supports many providers plus local LLMs in one client
Perpetual license with one year of updates
caveats: Requires macOS 13.0 or newer; not available on Windows, Linux, iPhone or iPad
Requires a separate OpenAI API key and billing; ChatGPT Plus is not needed
Free plan is limited to 5 conversations and 10 Inline uses per day; premium features need paid license (Basic $29, Personal $49, Standard $69)
